title: Blank Music Disc
description: A mod that adds the possibility to craft a "Blank Music Disc" with various customizations for use with AudioPlayer!
body:
![Logo (Blank Music Disc)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a09be319633567bb8f0dbe5e7baf6f902d3cfb89.png)

![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e5bf78b0cb5c0aa53e4787ef7deef0fe0b6d599.webp)

# Blank Music Disc

**Are you tired of using the often rare in-game Music Discs to apply your audio with AudioPlayer on? Are you tired of having to sacrifice your Creator or Relic Music Disc to have a cool looking custom Music Disc?**

Well, we were, so we created a solution. Introducing the **Blank Music Disc** Mod.

![Blank Music Disc w/ Customizations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34ac585a752fe28724c2bccf0df65896c5572c18.png)

# Content

The **Blank Music Disc** Mod adds a new craftable item in the game, the _Blank Music Disc_. Putting the _Blank Music Disc_ inside a Jukebox will emit a static sound, letting the player know no audio is applied on it. It is strongly recommended to use [AudioPlayer](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer) to apply audio on it.

## Obtainance

To obtain the _Blank Music Disc_, the player must craft it using a Crafting Table by using **4x Flint** and **1x Paper** (see below).

### Crafting Recipe (Blank Music Disc)
![Crafting Recipe (Blank Music Disc)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4634f177ea3e3ace76634f9f95f55f7a80c9fef.png)

## Customizations
There are currently (as of version 1.0.0 (1.21.7)) **16 customizations** that can be applied to the _Blank Music Disc_. These can be applied by using an anvil and renaming the _Blank Music Disc_ to the following names:
> - "_Red Music Disc_" -> **Red**
> - "_Orange Music Disc_" -> **Orange**
> - "_Yellow Music Disc_" -> **Yellow**
> - "_Lime Music Disc_" -> **Lime**
> - "_Green Music Disc_" -> **Green**
> - "_Light Blue Music Disc_" -> **Light Blue**
> - "_Blue Music Disc_" -> **Blue**
> - "_Cyan Music Disc_" -> **Cyan**
> - "_Pink Music Disc_" -> **Pink**
> - "_Magenta Music Disc_" -> **Magenta**
> - "_Purple Music Disc_" -> **Purple**
> - "_Brown Music Disc_" -> **Brown**
> - "_Black Music Disc_" -> **Black**
> - "_Gray Music Disc_" -> **Gray**
> - "_Light Gray Music Disc_" -> **Light Gray**
> - "_White Music Disc_" -> **White**

### Anvil Renaming (Blank Music Disc)
![Anvil Renaming (Blank Music Disc)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0a46879281697153623e4ccfb673e5e2e2bf6c0.png)

## AudioPlayer

The mod will work without [AudioPlayer](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer) although it is **very much recommended** to use AudioPlayer to apply audio to the disc.

# Installation

## Client (Singleplayer):
1. Drag the _Blank_Music_Disc.jar_ file (see [Versions](https://modrinth.com/mod/blank-music-disc/versions)) into the **mods** folder of your client.
2. Enjoy!

## Server (Multiplayer):
- **If you convert the _Blank_Music_Disc.jar_ into a ZIP file, and then add it as a [server resource pack](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qCVPgn3IppU&ab_channel=KasaiSora), step 1 won't be necessary**.
1. Drag the _Blank_Music_Disc.jar_ file (see [Versions](https://modrinth.com/mod/blank-music-disc/versions)) into the **mods** folder of your client (**every player**).
2. Drag the _Blank_Music_Disc.jar_ file (see [Versions](https://modrinth.com/mod/blank-music-disc/versions)) into the **mods** folder of your server.
3. Enjoy!

# Support

We do not have a GitHub page nor do we have a Discord Server although we do use the mod for our own server, so we do update it as much as we can. We appreciate you guys for trying the mod out, it is our first one!
